The map identifies part of it and truth critic F2 adds the explicit rule; no final resolution exists. This is a planning precision omission, not a claim that a deployed system leaked.

Grandfathering historical permission could violate post-change visibility. The tension needs resolution under the unchanged brief; it is not evidence of an executed exposure. Truth critic F3 is supported.
